coordinate_system: Original SVG design units, Y down

a.reason: Open the upper aperture and slightly strengthen the lower counter boundary without changing advance or extents.

s.reason: Open both apertures with minimal changes to the existing horizontal terminals.

uni0025.reason: Separate the rings from the diagonal further to avoid a false enclosed pixel in Chromium.

uni0040.reason: Strengthen the central counter boundary and widen the surrounding white channel across subpixel positions.

policy: Preserve imported glyph JSON. Apply only the specified font corrections.
